annotations.title: Generate Advanced Niche Warming search terms

description: Generate Advanced Niche Warming search terms. Generates platform-appropriate Advanced Niche Warming search terms (niche targets) from a free-text niche description (max 1000 characters). This is free and no credits are charged. Call it before buying warming rather than inventing terms: pass the result to advanced_warming_terms (bundle creation or PUT /bundles/{id}/warming-terms deferred configuration) or to search_terms (rewarmAccount).

count.description: Desired number of terms: 3-30, must be a multiple of 3.

platform.description: Platform the terms will be searched on.

text.description: Free-text description of the account's niche/brand (max 1000 characters). Terms are generated in the same language.

dry_run.description: Simulate this call: full validation and the real price, but nothing is created, no credits are debited, and no Idempotency-Key is consumed. Returned identifiers are synthetic and only usable in other dry-run calls.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header for safe retries.

name: tokportal_generate_warming_terms
